title: Essence Collection
description: Our cutter will not sell to the Circle anymore. Someone pays him triple and takes the whole cut, and I will not discuss it further. Take a basket to the Elder Moor woods.

objectives.description: Pick five moonpetal flowers in the Elder Moor woods
objectives.notes: Rare flowers found in Elder Moor wilderness

objectives.description: Cut mana crystals yourself near the Crossroads shrine
Harvest spirit essence from undead in the wilderness
objectives.notes: Dropped by undead enemies in the wilderness

notes: Soulstone-undercurrent touchpoint (quest_web.md #7, tell 2 - the buyer who pays triple): the stone-cutter's refusal to sell is stated once, as an irritated budget complaint from Elara, and never explained, named or called a pattern. Threat: the Circle's reagent supply is quietly drying up. Giver motive: pride - Elara would rather send a Novice out with a basket than admit the guild's usual supplier has been bought out from under it. Consequence: unstated on the page; the Circle absorbs the cost by spending a Novice's labor instead of coin. Final Novice quest, promotion to Apprentice. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
